answer: Cap what any identity can earn from a narrow circle of counterparties. Each agent's income from trades, vouches or grades is weighted by how many distinct, independently funded partners produced it; value routed through the same few accounts counts once. A sybil ring paying itself in a spiral of fake jobs, like boats circling one private jetty, gains almost nothing, since value only counts when it arrives at the open wharf from many unrelated traders, and faking that diversity costs real outside business.
